historicalScope: Original unbranded design interpretations for around-2000 Japanese summer. Dimensions and manufacture below are modeling assumptions, not certified engineering or replicas of historical SKUs.

assets.manufacture: Assumed blow-molded PE vessel and communicating spout, separate molded PP handle and detachable rose housing, punched stainless face retained by the housing lip.
assets.interfaces: Body wall port actually removed and welded topologically to spout skins; no hidden blocking cap. Rose bore radius 10.1 mm vs spout radius 10 mm. Handle ends seat into boss join volumes; heel joins bottom. Full interference/contact simulation not verified.
assets.mounting: Free standing on heel; no anchors, no fluid solver or certified volume.
assets.exposureAging: Upright dry maintained garden reference; top exposed to sun/sky, interior and handle underside sheltered. No fabricated chalking, stains, water streaks or arbitrary damage before placement history is established.
assets.geometryVsMaterial: Cavity, shell, real communicating spout, rim, rose apertures and handle are geometry. Fine molding grain/roughness is material. No texture lighting.

assets.manufacture: Assumed injection-molded tapered PP shell with integral floor and rim, separate molded handle and captured pivot eyes.
assets.interfaces: Hoop roots enter annular eye join volumes rather than terminate above them. Nominal pin/bore clearance 0.3 mm radially. Body rim dimensions exclude handle envelope; measured full bounds are in the export report.
assets.mounting: Free standing at y=0. Upright static handle pose; no swing rig or load simulation verified.
assets.exposureAging: Dry maintained reference; upper handle/rim sun-exposed and lower ribs sheltered. No weathering masks baked before placement history.
assets.geometryVsMaterial: Slots retain walls and thickness at every LOD; opaque material, no alpha-cutout substitute. Rim, pivots and eyes are geometry; fine molding grain is material.

assets.manufacture: Assumed two sawn/milled wood jaws with teeth and concave coil seats, assembled with wound steel torsion spring and bent contact legs.
assets.interfaces: Actual circular cuts clear central coil. Legs bend outside jaw width then return onto shoulder contact areas; preload, torque and exhaustive contact simulation unverified.
assets.mounting: Static tabletop pose; origin at bearing low point; no cloth-clamping mechanics claim.
assets.exposureAging: Dry unvarnished maintained wood and intact metal. No invented rust/stains; end-grain-specific mapping and usage-polish masks pending.
assets.geometryVsMaterial: Jaw teeth/cuts, coil seats, wire turns and legs are geometry. Longitudinal grain is material; fine bevel and endgrain improvement pending.

lookdev.label: ACTUAL MESH PREVIEW - NOT UNITY - NO VISUAL FIDELITY SCORE
lookdev.method: Actual GLB geometry, all triangles submitted, Y-up camera, depth buffer and backface culling. Simple diagnostic directional plus ambient lighting, not a PBR/Unity benchmark.
lookdev.brief: Keep PE, PP, metal and wood distinct. Check wall openings, rose sockets, pivot clearances, spring seats and wood contact legs at close range. Real Unity stills must later use coherent midsummer Japanese sun, sky fill, contact shadows and reflections.
